materials.title: Знакомство и опыт жизни за границей · B1
materials.text:
Teacher: Where are you from originally?
Learner: I’m originally from Russia, but I live in China now.
Teacher: How long have you lived there?
Learner: I’ve lived there for about eight years.
Teacher: What other languages do you speak?
Learner: I also speak Chinese, and I’m working on my English.

materials.title: Знакомство и опыт жизни за границей · B2
materials.text:
Teacher: How long have you been living in China?
Learner: For about eight years. I’ve also travelled to a lot of countries, so I get to use different languages in everyday situations.
Teacher: Which language has been harder for you to learn?
Learner: Chinese has challenged me in different ways. With English, my priority is speaking more fluently in live conversations.

materials.title: Знакомство и опыт жизни за границей · C1
materials.text:
Teacher: How has living abroad shaped the way you learn languages?
Learner: It’s made me rely more on using a language in real situations. I’ve been living in China for several years, and travel has also shown me how differently people express the same idea.
Teacher: What would you improve next?
Learner: I’d like to respond more spontaneously in English while keeping my explanations precise.

materials.title: Один лишний билет на футбол · B1
materials.text:
James: I’m taking my nephew to a football match on Saturday. I’ve got a spare ticket. Do you want to come?
Learner: I’m having lunch with my mum. What time does the match start?
James: It starts at five.
Learner: Great. I’ll come, then.

materials.title: Один лишний билет на футбол · B2
materials.text:
James: I’m taking my nephew to his first match on Saturday and I’ve got a spare ticket. Would you be interested?
Learner: I’m having lunch with my mum, so it depends on the kick-off time.
James: It starts at five. I’ve just checked.
Learner: In that case I’ll take the ticket. I’ll message you when I’m on my way.

materials.title: Один лишний билет на футбол · C1
materials.text:
James: I’m taking my nephew to his first match this Saturday. Someone dropped out, so I’ve got a spare ticket if you fancy it.
Learner: I’m already having lunch with my mum, but I could make it if the match starts late enough. What time’s kick-off?
James: Five o’clock. The stadium gates open earlier, so we’re meeting outside at four thirty.
Learner: That works for me. I’ll take the spare ticket and meet you there.

materials.title: Четыре формы будущего · B1
materials.text:
Teacher: You have no plans for Friday. What do you say?
Learner: Maybe I’ll go to the theatre.
Teacher: Now you’ve made a plan.
Learner: I’m going to see a play.
Teacher: What does the timetable say?
Learner: The play starts at seven.
Teacher: And now you’ve booked the tickets with a friend?
Learner: We’re seeing the play on Friday.

materials.title: Четыре формы будущего · B2
materials.text:
Teacher: Why do we say ‘the performance starts at seven’?
Learner: The time is fixed by the timetable. It’s independent of my own plan.
Teacher: Give me a spontaneous decision and an earlier intention.
Learner: ‘I’ll lend you my calculator’ is an offer I’m making now. ‘I’m going to take two days off’ is something I’d already decided.
Teacher: And a firm arrangement?
Learner: ‘I’m meeting my friend at the theatre on Friday.’

materials.title: Четыре формы будущего · C1
materials.text:
Teacher: Could you use two different forms for the same Friday plan?
Learner: Yes. ‘I’m going to see the play’ presents it as an intention. ‘I’m seeing the play with Alex on Friday’ presents it as an arrangement.
Teacher: Where would the present simple fit?
Learner: ‘The performance starts at seven’ refers to the published schedule. And if I decide during this conversation, I could say, ‘All right, I’ll come too.’

materials.title: После занятия: план и спонтанное решение · B1
materials.text:
Partner: What are you going to do after class?
Learner: I’m going to have dinner. I might go for a walk later.
Partner: Do you want some company?
Learner: Sure. I’ll text you after dinner.

materials.title: После занятия: план и спонтанное решение · B2
materials.text:
Teacher: Choose one of the topics and tell your partner your plans.
Learner: After class I’m going to have dinner and relax. If the weather’s good, I might go for a walk in the park.
Partner: Shall we meet there?
Learner: That sounds good. I’ll check the weather and get back to you.

materials.title: После занятия: план и спонтанное решение · C1
materials.text:
Partner: Have you decided what you’re doing after class?
Learner: I’m going to have dinner first. I haven’t made up my mind about the rest of the evening, though I might go for a walk if it clears up.
Partner: I’m meeting a friend near the park around eight.
Learner: In that case I’ll check how I feel after dinner and let you know whether I can join you.

materials.title: Выбери форму будущего
materials.prompt: Скажи четыре фразы про пятницу: решение в момент разговора, уже принятое намерение, опубликованное время начала и договорённость с другом.
materials.answer: I'll go on Friday, then. / I'm going to see a play. / The performance starts at seven. / I'm meeting Alex at six thirty.

materials.title: Попроси повторить и обсуди порядок
materials.prompt: Попроси собеседника повторить вторую реплику. Объясни, какая часть звонка идёт первой и почему.
materials.answer: Could you read the second line again? I think C comes first because James explains why he's calling.

materials.title: Планы на вечер
materials.prompt: Скажи, что собираешься делать после урока, и добавь вариант, который ещё не решил.
materials.answer: I'm going to have dinner after class. I haven't made up my mind about the rest of the evening. I might go for a walk.

materials.answer: Dinner and relaxing are planned. A walk depends on the weather. During the exchange he decides to check the weather and get back to his partner.

materials.title: Чтение и ответ · После занятия: план и спонтанное решение · C1
materials.text:

Write a reply to the invitation that acknowledges the plan, gives a condition and promises an update without committing to meet.

materials.title: ACE TEFL · телефонный разговор целиком по смыслу
materials.text:
Адаптация диалога из Grammar Lesson Task Sheet, задания 1–2. Сохранены все четыре части и последовательность разговора.

C — James: Hi Richard. I’m taking my nephew Sam to his first football match this Saturday. United are playing City and I’ve got an extra ticket. Would you like to come?
Richard: I’d love to, but I’m having lunch at my mum’s. What time is the match?

A — James: It starts at five. I just checked online.
Richard: Then I’d have to leave about half three. I’m sure Mum won’t mind. I’ll tell her it’s something important.
James: What could be more important than a first football match?

D — Richard: Have you decided how to get there? Are you going to take the train like last time?
James: I’m going to drive. My sister is dropping Sam off at my place around three. I’ll pick you up from your mum’s if you like.
Richard: That’d be great. What time?

B — James: We’d better leave about four, just to be on the safe side.
Richard: It’ll probably be busy. See you at four, then.
James: See you!

materials.title: ACE TEFL · 1. Восстанови порядок звонка
materials.prompt:
Arrange the parts from the first line to the goodbye.
A. James checks the starting time. Richard decides what to tell his mum.
B. They agree to leave around four and say goodbye.
C. James offers a ticket. Richard mentions his lunch plan.
D. They discuss driving, Sam’s drop-off and Richard’s pick-up.
Explain how you recognised the beginning and the end.
materials.answer: C → A → D → B. C gives the reason for the call. B fixes the final time and closes the conversation.

materials.title: ACE TEFL · 2. Разбери смысл всех будущих форм
materials.prompt:
Use the reading material «ACE TEFL · телефонный разговор целиком по смыслу».
1 Has James got tickets? What suggests Sam’s mum knows the plan?
2 Does Richard already have a lunch arrangement? Do we know the exact lunch time?
3 Is five o’clock a personal arrangement or a published time?
4 Did Richard plan what to say to his mum before the call?
5 Has James already chosen how to travel? What does he offer to do during the call?
6 Is Richard certain it will be busy? Which word tells you?
materials.answer:
1 Yes, he has an extra ticket. The drop-off has already been arranged with his sister, Sam’s mum.
2 Yes. The dialogue does not give an exact lunch time.
3 A published time: it starts at five.
4 He decides during the call: I’ll tell her.
5 Yes: I’m going to drive. He then offers: I’ll pick you up.
6 No. Probably expresses a prediction with uncertainty.

materials.title: ACE TEFL · 3. Will или going to, десять ситуаций
materials.prompt:
Fill in the gaps with will or be going to. Adapted from the 10 situations on the worksheet.
1. Can I speak to somebody in Accounts? — I ___ (put) you through.
2. My calculator’s broken. — I ___ (lend) you mine.
3. That’s why I ___ (take) two days off next week. I’ve already decided.
4. We need someone to come over. — I ___ (send) someone round immediately.
5. The new kitchen’s a bit dark, so we ___ (paint) it yellow.
6. I’ve decided I ___ (work) harder next year.
7. What about a birthday party? — Maybe I ___ (stay) home.
8. We’ve decided we ___ (not sell) the house after all.
9. Did Accounts email you? — I ___ (check) my inbox.
10. Are you friends again? — No, I ___ (never speak) to him again.
materials.answer:
1 I’ll put, 2 I’ll lend, 3 I’m going to take, 4 I’ll send, 5 we’re going to paint, 6 I’m going to work, 7 I’ll stay, 8 we aren’t going to sell, 9 I’ll check, 10 I’ll never speak.
In 10, ‘I’m never going to speak to him again’ also works if the speaker is reporting an existing intention. The will version works as an emphatic decision or vow.

materials.title: ACE TEFL · 4. Расписание или договорённость
materials.prompt:
Choose the form that fits the situation best.
1 I’m meeting / I’ll meet a friend at the pub at eight tonight. It’s arranged.
2 The train is leaving / leaves at 15:15 according to the timetable.
3 Did you forget? Two friends will come over / are coming over tonight.
4 I can’t make it tomorrow morning. I see / am seeing the dentist at nine.
5 The Tuesday lesson is starting / starts at ten according to the schedule.
6 We’ve set a wedding date. We will get married / are getting married on 6 August.
materials.answer: 1 I’m meeting, 2 leaves, 3 are coming over, 4 am seeing, 5 starts, 6 are getting married. Schedules typically take present simple, arrangements typically take present continuous in these contexts.

materials.title: ACE TEFL · 5. Минута о будущем, все 13 тем
materials.prompt:
Choose one prompt. Speak for at least a minute without naming it. Let a partner guess it, or write what clues a reader could use to guess it.
1 A party or celebration you’re planning.
2 Journeys in the next few months.
3 Your career plans.
4 Upcoming sporting fixtures and your predictions.
5 The weather over the next seven days.
6 The rest of this week.
7 The world 80 years from now.
8 This weekend.
9 Your hopes for the future.
10 This evening.
11 Your next birthday.
12 Your life in ten years.
13 What you’ll do with your money in the next few months.
materials.answer: Model for a weekend: I’m meeting a friend on Saturday. Our train leaves at nine. If the weather holds, we’re going to spend the afternoon outdoors. I think it’ll be fairly busy, so I’ll check whether we need to book. A listener can guess the topic from Saturday and the sequence of plans.

materials.title: Реплики преподавателя · 12 фраз с переводом и примерами
materials.text:
Таймкоды от начала файла, в формате часы:минуты. Фразы сверены с расшифровкой и местами нормализованы, чтобы их было удобно повторять. Примеры после каждой фразы составлены для практики.

00:10–00:12 · Have a think about it for a moment.
Перевод: Подумай об этом немного.
Конструкция: Разговорное британское have a think about; нейтральное think about it.
Твой пример для практики: Let’s have a think about the timing before we decide.

00:10–00:12 · I’ve put the task sheet in the chat.
Перевод: Я отправил лист с заданием в чат.
Конструкция: Present Perfect сообщает о результате, важном сейчас.
Твой пример для практики: I’ve put the link in the chat so everyone can open it.

00:10–00:12 · Discuss what you think is the correct order.
Перевод: Обсудите, какой порядок кажется вам правильным.
Конструкция: what you think is… — встроенный вопрос; discuss без about.
Твой пример для практики: Can we discuss what we think is the best option?

00:10–00:12 · Are you saying you can’t see the screen?
Перевод: Ты хочешь сказать, что не видишь экран?
Конструкция: Are you saying (that)…? — проверка понимания.
Твой пример для практики: Are you saying the link doesn’t work?

00:18–00:20 · Have they set a time for lunch?
Перевод: Они уже назначили время обеда?
Конструкция: set a time for — назначить время для чего-либо.
Твой пример для практики: Have we set a time for the next call?

00:18–00:20 · Can he make it to the stadium?
Перевод: Он сможет добраться до стадиона / успеть?
Конструкция: make it to + место; make it at + время.
Твой пример для практики: I can make it to the meeting if we start at four.

00:18–00:20 · If the match was at two, he probably wouldn’t be able to go.
Перевод: Если бы матч был в два, он, наверное, не смог бы пойти.
Конструкция: if + Past Simple, would + глагол для гипотезы.
Твой пример для практики: If the lesson started at noon, I probably wouldn’t be able to join.

00:36–00:38 · When did she decide to put him through?
Перевод: Когда она решила соединить его по телефону?
Конструкция: После did — decide, не decided; put someone through to + отдел.
Твой пример для практики: When did you decide to book the tickets?

00:36–00:38 · Let me correct myself.
Перевод: Дай мне поправиться.
Конструкция: let me + глагол; correct myself — исправить себя.
Твой пример для практики: Let me correct myself. I meant Thursday, not Tuesday.

00:40–00:42 · Let’s look at some more examples.
Перевод: Давай посмотрим ещё несколько примеров.
Конструкция: some more + исчисляемое во мн. числе или неисчисляемое.
Твой пример для практики: Let’s look at another example before we move on.

00:46–00:48 · Do you remember the difference?
Перевод: Помнишь, в чём разница?
Конструкция: the difference between X and Y.
Твой пример для практики: Do you remember the difference between an intention and an arrangement?

00:58–01:00 · That’ll be all for today. Take care.
Перевод: На сегодня всё. Всего доброго.
Конструкция: That’ll be all for today — завершение занятия; Take care — прощание.
Твой пример для практики: That’ll be all for today. See you next week!

materials.title: Грамматика урока · правила, формы и примеры
materials.text:
Четыре формы будущего
- **Will + глагол** — решение в момент речи, предложение, обещание или прогноз: I’ll lend you mine. It’ll probably be busy.
- **Am/is/are going to + глагол** — ранее принятое намерение или прогноз на основе того, что видно сейчас: I’m going to drive. Look at those clouds. It’s going to rain.
- **Present Continuous** — договорённость с деталями: I’m picking you up at four. The month, a booking or another person may help signal an arrangement, but context decides.
- **Present Simple** — расписание или программа: The match starts at five. The train leaves at 15:15.

Одно событие, разные взгляды
I’m going to see the play говорит о намерении. I’m seeing it with Alex on Friday подчёркивает договорённость. The play starts at seven сообщает время из расписания. All right, I’ll come too — решение сейчас. Во многих реальных контекстах подходят несколько форм, но они смещают смысл.

Отрицания и вопросы
I won’t sell it. We aren’t going to sell it. Are you going to drive? What time does the match start? После will, won’t и does используй начальную форму. Be going to согласуется с подлежащим: I am, she is, we are.

Будущее после if и when
If lunch runs late, I’ll text you. I’ll call you when I get there. Для будущего в таких придаточных обычно используется Present Simple. Гипотетическая ситуация устроена иначе: If the match started earlier, I wouldn’t be able to go.

Уверенность и момент решения
I’ll probably stay home сообщает предположение или предварительное решение. I’m sure she’ll understand показывает уверенный прогноз. I’ve already decided — решение принято к моменту речи. I’ve just checked online — время проверено только что, и результат сейчас нужен собеседнику.

materials.title: Грамматика · Один звонок · четыре формы
materials.text: Choose suitable forms for these blanks. The match ___ at five according to the schedule. My sister ___ Sam off at three, as we agreed. I’ve already decided I ___ (drive). You need a lift? I ___ (pick) you up. Explain each choice.
materials.prompt: Choose suitable forms for these blanks. The match ___ at five according to the schedule. My sister ___ Sam off at three, as we agreed. I’ve already decided I ___ (drive). You need a lift? I ___ (pick) you up. Explain each choice.
materials.answer: starts — timetable. is dropping — arrangement. am going to drive — earlier intention. ’ll pick — offer now.

materials.title: Грамматика · Решение сейчас или раньше
materials.text: Use will or going to: (1) I see dark clouds. It ___ (rain). (2) My phone’s dead. — No problem, I ___ (lend) you mine. (3) I’ve booked time off. I ___ (take) two days off. (4) I think the road ___ (be) busy.
materials.prompt: Use will or going to: (1) I see dark clouds. It ___ (rain). (2) My phone’s dead. — No problem, I ___ (lend) you mine. (3) I’ve booked time off. I ___ (take) two days off. (4) I think the road ___ (be) busy.
materials.answer: 1 is going to rain — present evidence. 2 ’ll lend — an offer made now. 3 am going to take — decided earlier. 4 will be — prediction based on opinion.

materials.title: Грамматика · If, when и отрицание
materials.text: Complete: If lunch ___ (run) late, I ___ (text) you. I’ll call you when I ___ (arrive). Rewrite We’re going to sell the house after all as a negative, and ask a question about the plan.
materials.prompt: Complete: If lunch ___ (run) late, I ___ (text) you. I’ll call you when I ___ (arrive). Rewrite We’re going to sell the house after all as a negative, and ask a question about the plan.
materials.answer: runs / ’ll text / arrive. We aren’t going to sell the house after all. Are you going to sell the house after all?

materials.title: Грамматика · Запланируй поездку и поправься
materials.text: Write five lines: an arrangement, a timetable, an earlier intention, an offer and a correction of the time using Let me correct myself.
materials.prompt: Write five lines: an arrangement, a timetable, an earlier intention, an offer and a correction of the time using Let me correct myself.
materials.answer: I’m meeting Maya outside the station. The train leaves at nine. We’re going to spend the day hiking. Need a lift to the station? I’ll pick you up. Let me correct myself. The train leaves at nine fifteen.
